name: app-cordis
description: Project Orca — Cordis(TypeScript) 版：Phase 1 飞书→AI 最小闭环 + Phase 2 信息获取框架（InfoAgent：Pull+Push、档案室 JSONL、food-agent、会话绑定路由、本地视觉、直连图片上传 /info/images）+ Phase 0+1 Persistent Context Runtime（OrcaEvent 流 + EventBus 滑动窗口 + feishu-adapter，默认关闭）+ Phase 2 WorldState Runtime（WorldStateService + Reducer 注册表 + WorldStateUpdater time tick + 3 个 mock 输入 adapter + debug publisher，Phase 2.A/2.C/2.D 完整闭环）+ Phase 3 Attention Engine（纯规则评估 + dedup + throttle + rule-registry + rule-config loader）+ Phase 4.A Decision Engine（纯决策层：AttentionItem → Decision，无副作用）

scripts.smoke:all: npm run smoke && npm run smoke:world-state && npm run smoke:attention && npm run smoke:decision
